set.body:
Outcome: identify and exercise the smallest real Sherlock visualization path in existing StoryAtlas, using existing StoryModel outputs; preserve source implementations and avoid new inference or a replacement application.
Scope: verify local annotation/recall inventory and one development participant, render checksum-bound saved Voyage documents through an isolated exact declared-pin Atlas build, inspect real UI behavior if browser ownership checks permit, and write docs/delivery/sherlock-dogfood.md with prioritized next slices and consumer feedback.
Acceptance: distinguish executed checks from proposals; record artifact hashes, revisions, commands and limitations; render exact existing posterior/decision records without reinterpreting clocks or granularity; list reproducible producer-contract gaps separately from Atlas UI fixes. No new scientific efficacy, held-out evaluation, current-main compatibility or full-workspace claims.
Reuse: VoyageCodecs, VoyageCompiler, VoyageLowering, VoyagePage, VoyageView, existing Sherlock annotation adapter and study output receipts. Use development partition material. Actual video stays local; no source text or movie bytes are committed.
Next actions remain under existing workspace/provider/film tickets; this bounded assessment and test drive must not become a competing roadmap. Consumer feedback stays in the document and related Mote notes, with exact evidence and expected behavior.
set.title: [Dogfood] Test-drive existing Sherlock outputs and record consumer feedback
